parsed.rationale: Three distinct types — `MaterialBlendMode`, `PlaybackBlendMode`, and `OverlayBlendMode` — all define a `blendMode` implementation at the same line number (62) within the `Wallpaper` package, which is the canonical signal for a default-implementation candidate. Because all three live in the same package (`Shared/Wallpaper/Sources/Wallpaper/Core/`) and share the identical method name and line position, the implementation is almost certainly identical or near-identical and can be hoisted into a protocol extension. Introducing a `BlendModeProvider` protocol with a default `blendMode` implementation in a new `BlendModeProvider.swift` file in the same package would eliminate the triplication while keeping all three conforming types intact. None of the records carry test, codegen, or sample-app flags, so there is no intentional-duplication exemption.
